text:
Since you are the sun, learn how to depart from the sun that learns light and joy from you; did you not see day die yesterday and quench its burning gold in the sea?


Then the air, asleep in cold shadow, grew black and sorrowful; then night lit as many consolations in the East as lights had burned.


Aminta, you rise for Silvio from the sunset in which you leave me buried and blind; darkened, I follow with uncertain step.


Grant my night and plea, from your sun's fire in which I burn, stars—the castoffs of your fire.

translation.title: To Aminta, That She Imitate the Sun and Leave Comfort When She Departs
